<includeonly><span class="pdx-good" style="color:#1a7f37;">{{{1|}}}</span></includeonly><noinclude>
== Purpose ==
Marks a numerically ''good'' value. '''pdxparse''' applies it automatically to
positive modifiers via <code>MessageTools.colourNum</code>. See {{tl|red}} for
the opposite.

<code>#1a7f37</code> is used rather than <code>green</code> so the text clears
WCAG AA contrast on the default white background.
